name: Search, collapse and expand, kind icons, eye and padlock per row
body:
# Outliner rows

A filter field above the rows (matches name and kind), a chevron to collapse a parent, an icon per kind (from the
palette's `markers` or a default), and eye/padlock toggles at the right of each row. Shift-click selects a range,
Ctrl-click toggles. Double-click renames inline.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27. Outliner.chaos search input, OutlinerRow.chaos chevron, kind icon (EditorModel.KindIcon), eye and lock toggles backed by lantern_editor_set_hidden/set_locked.
